verifier: Trust Proof Security Reliability Release Engine independent verifier

evidenceBoundary.environment: local exact sealed artifact with candidate leave-audit hardener applied

attack.hypothesis: Binding a leave decision to its request ID inside the same mutable tenant JSON does not provide independent tamper evidence when both decision and domain audit are rewritten together.

rootCause.description: The request outcome and request-bound domain audit are stored together in the mutable tenants.state JSON. The separately append-only audit_events entry contains only version and resultId, so startup and reads cannot correlate or detect a changed decision.
rootCause.workingControl: The leave audit now identifies the exact request and the database audit table is append-only.
rootCause.missingControl: An independently retained decision/reviewer/payload digest or hash-chain checkpoint enforced at startup and before consequential reads.

requiredRepair: Bind the exact request, decision, employee, reviewer, reviewed time and canonical payload/state digest to independently verifiable append-only evidence.
Verify the correlation at startup and before returning or exporting consequential leave state.
Fail closed with recovery evidence when domain state and immutable audit evidence diverge.
Prove known-good restore and exact reconciliation before reopening service.
nextProof: Make this fail-first regression pass on a newly sealed Node 22 artifact, then repeat the exact hosted leave journey, controlled restart and audit reconciliation on one admitted build.
safety: No hosted deployment, live database, customer record, payroll record, credential, DNS or infrastructure was changed.
